comment: Why: the wandering bosses are the one thing in the dungeon that cannot be fought and forgotten: a big body walks the room graph of its sector and the party must hide or run. Which bodies are on the list is data, so it can change without a rebuild. Every body here was chosen because it is physical (it hits, it does not cast), big enough to be frightening, and the Dungeon Master gives it a name, a health multiplier and a speed multiplier of its own. The Grimoire Daemons are not on the list on purpose: they belong to one boss and vanish with it. Unknown ids are skipped at run time, so an entry may name a mod that is not installed.

entries.name: The Warden
entries.comment: Our own boss and the signature wanderer: 200 health, heavy armour, a slow stride. Its boss bar is hidden and its Shadow Key is removed from its drops while it wanders.

entries.name: The Ravager
entries.comment: A vanilla heavy that charges: 100 health and a roar. Slightly slower than its own pace so that a head start is worth something.

entries.name: The Horned Bear
entries.comment: A Tensura bear, a plain heavy body: the entry-level wanderer, one that a first-sector party is meant to avoid rather than fight.

entries.name: The Empty Knight
entries.comment: Our Living Armor at four times its health: the same body the party has met in a patrol, grown into something that has to be avoided.

entries.name: The Armoured Lizard
entries.comment: A Tensura armoured lizard: a tough, slow body, a change from the mammals on the list.

entries.name: The Brute Captain
entries.comment: A piglin brute with two and a half times its health: an axe in a narrow corridor.

entries.name: The Giant Bear
entries.comment: A Tensura giant bear: the bigger bear, from threat 3.

entries.name: The Blade Tiger
entries.comment: A Tensura blade tiger: a big cat; its speed is cut to 0.8 so that hiding and running have room to work.

entries.name: The War Gnome
entries.comment: A Tensura war gnome with half again its health: a soldier-sized body on patrol.

entries.name: The Bone Reaper
entries.comment: A wither skeleton with four times its health: tall enough to see over half walls and every blow withers.

entries.name: The Gorger
entries.comment: A zoglin with two and a half times its health: it attacks anything, so it is loud in a fight and easy to hear.

entries.name: The Weaver
entries.comment: A Tensura black spider at double health: a spider body, for the variety of how things on the list move.

entries.name: The Basilisk
entries.comment: A Tensura basilisk: a heavy reptile body, from threat 4.

entries.name: The Knight Spider
entries.comment: A Tensura knight spider: the late-game spider body of the list, from threat 5.

entries.name: The Stone Colossus
entries.comment: An iron golem at double health: a machine that does not tire, slowed so a sprint can outrun it.
